	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	report_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	repository_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pattern_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	file_path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	line_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	line_end INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	suggestion TEXT NOT NULL, 
	code_evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	llm_explanation TEXT, 
	id UUID NOT NULL,

	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES github_repositories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE code_findings (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	report_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	repository_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pattern_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	file_path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	line_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	line_end INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	suggestion TEXT NOT NULL, 
	code_evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	llm_explanation TEXT, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES code_analysis_reports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES github_repositories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

	pattern_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	file_path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	line_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	line_end INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	suggestion TEXT NOT NULL, 
	code_evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	llm_explanation TEXT, 
	id UUID NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id),

CREATE TABLE users (
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255), 
	github_username VARCHAR(255), 
	target_role VARCHAR(255), 
	target_location VARCHAR(255), 
	experience_level VARCHAR(50), 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
